sloka: यानैश्च मुख्यैः परिचारकैश्च ।सुसम्वृता गच्छतु राजपुत्री ।वस्रैश्च सर्वैः सहितैर्विधानै ।र्नेयम् वृता ते वरसम्प्रदाने ॥२-३७-३६॥
transliteration: yānaiśca mukhyaiḥ paricārakaiśca ।susamvṛtā gacchatu rājaputrī ।vasraiśca sarvaiḥ sahitairvidhānai ।rneyam vṛtā te varasampradāne ॥2-37-36॥

translations.english: Equipped with excellent chariots, attendants, garments, and all other needs let the princess (Sita) go. While seeking boons, you did not include Sita.
